title: Notify interest in a liquor licence business
summary: Learn how to officially notify Liquor & Gaming NSW if you obtain an interest in a liquor licence business.
intro:
If you obtain an interest in a liquor licence business, you'll need to officially notify Liquor & Gaming NSW within 28 days.

If you have the necessary authorisation, you can notify online.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Any person or organisation other than the liquor licensee or a financial institution, who becomes interested in a liquor licence business (except a limited licence).
what_you_need: Personal and contact details (if an individual)
Name, ABN, ACN, and contact details (if an organisation)
A current ASIC extract, or the names of all directors and officeholders (if the organisation is a proprietary company/Pty Ltd)

how_to_steps.text: Enter your liquor licence number (including the letters) and your name.

more_info.text: When uploading, ensure all the documents are in PDF format.
To find your liquor licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: How long do I have to notify Liquor & Gaming NSW?
faqs.a: You must officially notify Liquor & Gaming NSW within 28 days of obtaining an interest in a liquor licence business.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to notify interest in a liquor licence business?
faqs.a: Any person or organisation, other than the liquor licensee or a financial institution, who becomes interested in a liquor licence business (except a limited licence) can notify.

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date liquor licence guidelines?
faqs.a: Visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page for guidelines, resources, and tools.
